name: AuMas Resources Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，公告主要为诉讼、地址变更、公司秘书变动及股东大会等事项。最新一季营收同比增长97.7%，但公告中未说明具体业务变化。
overview_en: There were no announcements this year involving expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments; announcements mainly covered litigation, change of address, change of company secretary, and general meetings. Latest quarterly revenue grew 97.7% year-on-year, but no specific business changes were disclosed in the announcements.
